title: Ben Solo is born on Chandrila
summary: Leia Organa goes into labor at the Galactic Concordance ceremony on Chandrila, and Han hurries her off to a hospital, where she delivers their son, Ben Solo. The son of two war heroes will one day call himself Kylo Ren.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Republic and Empire stand down their militaries
note: Follows the Galactic Concordance, dated 5 ABY; the Republic's own Military Disarmament Act passed c. 4 ABY.
summary: With the war formally over, the New Republic and what is left of the Empire halt hostilities and begin disarming. Mon Mothma's Republic keeps only a small defense force, a choice that leaves it exposed when a new Imperial threat rises.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Inner systems' Imperial remnant falls apart
summary: The Concordance lets loyalist Core and Inner Rim worlds such as Commenor, Rendili and Denon form an Imperial rump state, but it collapses almost at once in bickering. Many of its worlds later drift into the Senate's Centrist bloc.
sources: Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy

title: Imperial holdouts regroup in the Unknown Regions
summary: After a flight of several months, Rae Sloane and Brendol Hux reach the late Emperor's dreadnought Eclipse and link up with other Imperials who escaped into uncharted space. The hidden remnant grows strong and starts turning the ice world Ilum into a superweapon.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Luke begins hunting lost Jedi lore
note: Dated 29 years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY) by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
summary: With the Empire beaten, Luke Skywalker starts combing the galaxy for scraps of Jedi knowledge the Empire tried to erase, gathering texts and relics he hopes will let him rebuild the order.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: The Cosmic Force falls quiet
note: The span runs until the Force stirs again around the Starkiller Incident.
summary: Once the Galactic Civil War ends, the Cosmic Force lies dormant, barely sensed even by those attuned to it. It stirs again in 34 ABY, when latent gifts such as Rey's and Finn's begin to wake.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Luke uncovers Jocasta Nu's hidden school
summary: Luke finds the buried refuge where Jedi archivist Jocasta Nu, after Order 66, stored holocrons of her teachings on a remote world. Its recovered knowledge feeds his effort to revive the Jedi.

title: Fenril sector breaks with the New Republic
note: Marvel's Star Wars (2025) is set about two years after Return of the Jedi.
summary: Pirates gut Republic convoys near Sullust, and Kezrin Almovar, Prime Minister of Pirros, throws the New Republic out of a trade summit, cutting the Fenril sector off. Behind the crisis stands the Anzati mystic Reyna Oskure.

title: Nagai revolt frees Nagi
summary: Enslaved Nagai rise up on Kaltrais with help from Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Rynn Zenat, seize ships, and carry the fight home to Nagi. The crisis ends with Nagi free and its people allied to the New Republic.

title: Han and Lando stop a droid-revolt plot
summary: Han and Lando Calrissian race to find a device called the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, which can make droids murder organics, before its maker Fyzen Gor unleashes it on Cloud City. Han kills Gor and the transmitter is destroyed.
wp: Search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter

title: Morgan Elsbeth has a Republic envoy killed
note: Falls during Elsbeth's rule of Calodan, which began no earlier than 7 ABY and ended with its liberation in 9 ABY; placed mid-range.
summary: New Republic ambassador Nadura comes to Calodan on Corvus to bring the world into the Republic. Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth refuses, her guards cut down the escort, and the fleeing envoy dies when her ship is blown apart.

title: Shara Bey teaches young Poe to fly
note: Poe was six, per The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary.
summary: On Yavin 4, retired rebel pilot Shara Bey sits six-year-old Poe Dameron in her lap and lets him work the controls of her old A-wing, the start of a life spent flying.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Din Djarin claims the bounty on Grogu
summary: An Imperial remnant hires hunters to fetch a Force-sensitive infant of Yoda's species. The Mandalorian Din Djarin reaches him first on Arvala-7, shooting the rival droid IG-11 to keep the child alive, and begins the bond that will make Grogu his son.

title: Din Djarin takes Grogu back from the Client
summary: After handing the child to the Client on Nevarro for a hoard of beskar, Din has second thoughts and snatches him back, breaking the Bounty Hunters' Guild code. Nevarro's Mandalorian covert fights off the hunters to cover his escape.

title: Din's allies drive Gideon from Nevarro City
summary: Din, Cara Dune, Greef Karga, Kuiil and a rebuilt IG-11 fight Moff Gideon's troops in Nevarro City. Kuiil is killed, IG-11 destroys himself to save Grogu, and Gideon crawls from his downed fighter holding the Darksaber.

title: Din Djarin meets Bo-Katan's Nite Owls
summary: On Trask, Din learns that not all Mandalorians share his covert's creed when the Nite Owls under Bo-Katan Kryze save him. After raiding an Imperial freighter together, she sends him to find the Jedi Ahsoka Tano on Corvus.

title: Ahsoka Tano frees Calodan and names Grogu
summary: Ahsoka Tano and Din Djarin topple Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth's rule over Calodan on Corvus. Ahsoka learns the child's name is Grogu but declines to train him, and demands that Elsbeth reveal where Grand Admiral Thrawn is hiding.

title: Dark troopers seize Grogu on Tython
summary: Grogu reaches out through the Force from a seeing stone on Tython. Boba Fett, with Fennec Shand, arrives to reclaim his armor and helps defend him, but Gideon's dark troopers carry the child off and the Razor Crest is blown up.

title: Luke Skywalker takes Grogu for training
summary: Din's strike team storms Moff Gideon's cruiser; Din beats Gideon, wins the Darksaber, and takes him prisoner. When dark troopers close in, Luke Skywalker cuts through them, and Din takes off his helmet to bid Grogu farewell as the child leaves with the Jedi.

title: Boba Fett seizes Jabba's old palace
summary: Boba Fett storms Jabba's palace on Tatooine with Fennec Shand, kills the usurper Bib Fortuna, and takes the throne. Styling himself daimyo, he tries to rule Jabba's former territory with respect rather than fear.
sources: Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land

title: The Armorer casts out Din Djarin
summary: Paz Vizsla challenges Din for the Darksaber in the covert hidden on Glavis Ringworld. Learning that Din has shown his face, the Armorer declares him an apostate, outside the Creed, and sends him away.

title: Grogu leaves Luke's academy for Din
note: The temple's world, unnamed on screen, is identified as Ossus by Shadow of the Sith.
summary: On Ossus, where Luke is raising his first temple, Grogu trains in the Force. Offered Yoda's lightsaber or the beskar mail Din sent him, he chooses the armor, gives up Jedi training, and rejoins Din on Tatooine.
sources: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor

title: Boba Fett's gotra beats the Pykes
summary: After the Pyke Syndicate bombs the Sanctuary cantina, Fett's gotra, Freetown's militia and Din Djarin fight the Pykes and the crime families backing them through Mos Espa. Fett kills Cad Bane, Fennec Shand wipes out the Pyke bosses, and Fett holds Tatooine.
sources: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor

title: Din bathes in Mandalore's Living Waters
note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
summary: Seeking redemption, Din descends into the ruins of Mandalore and, guided by Bo-Katan Kryze, immerses himself in the Living Waters, proving the world can still support life. Pulling him from the depths, Bo-Katan glimpses a living mythosaur.

title: Penn Pershing's rehabilitation goes wrong
note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
summary: On Coruscant the New Republic's Amnesty Program houses former Imperials like cloning scientist Penn Pershing. When he tries to resume his research, Republic troops arrest him, and fellow Amnesty officer Elia Kane, secretly loyal to Gideon, wipes his mind.

title: Mandalorians free Nevarro from pirates
note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
summary: When the New Republic won't defend Nevarro from Gorian Shard's pirates, Bo-Katan leads the Tribe's warriors to retake the city. Shard dies with his flagship, and the Armorer charges Bo-Katan with reuniting all Mandalorians.

title: The Imperial Shadow Council meets in secret
note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
summary: Escaped from Republic custody, Moff Gideon meets the warlords of a revived Shadow Council, among them Gilad Pellaeon and Brendol Hux. They squabble over resources as Hux touts Project Necromancer and Pellaeon hints at Thrawn's return.

title: Mandalorians retake Mandalore from Gideon
note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
summary: Bo-Katan's reunited Mandalorians land on their homeworld, join survivors of the Purge and storm Gideon's hidden base. Gideon dies with his clones, the Great Forge burns again, and Din formally adopts his foundling as Din Grogu.

title: Ahsoka races Elsbeth for the map to Thrawn
note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
summary: The Dark Jedi Shin Hati and her master Baylan Skoll free Morgan Elsbeth from Republic custody, destroying the cruiser Vesper. Ahsoka Tano recovers a star map to Thrawn's place of exile from Arcana, but Shin steals it on Lothal after wounding Sabine Wren.

title: The Eye of Sion jumps to another galaxy
note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
summary: At Seatos, Elsbeth's hyperspace ring carries her, Baylan, Shin and Sabine Wren, who bargains her way aboard to reach Ezra, to Peridea in a distant galaxy. Ahsoka, knocked from a cliff, meets Anakin's spirit in a realm between worlds, then follows on a purrgil.

title: Grand Admiral Thrawn escapes exile
note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
summary: On Peridea, Thrawn outwits Ahsoka's party and departs aided by the Nightsister Great Mothers, emerging at Dathomir with his Star Destroyer. Morgan Elsbeth falls to Ahsoka and Ezra Bridger gets home, but Ahsoka and Sabine are stranded.
sources: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord

title: Four At Attin children escape the Barrier
note: Lucasfilm places Skeleton Crew in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian and Ahsoka; its order within 9 ABY is not established.
summary: Fern, KB, Wim and Neel, children of the sealed-off world At Attin, stumble on a buried starship and blast past the Barrier into the lawless galaxy, where they fall in with the scheming Force-user Jod Na Nawood.
sources: This Could Be a Real Adventure
Way, Way Out Past the Barrier

title: Pirates invade At Attin
note: Lucasfilm places Skeleton Crew in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian and Ahsoka; its order within 9 ABY is not established.
summary: Jod Na Nawood, the pirate captain Silvo, wins back his crew from the mutineer Brutus and uses the children's ship to pass At Attin's Barrier and loot its mint. The kids and their parents fight back, the Barrier falls, and New Republic fighters arrive.
sources: We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble

title: Shara Bey dies on Yavin 4
summary: Bloodburn kills rebel veteran Shara Bey at the family home on Yavin 4, leaving her husband Kes and eight-year-old Poe. Leia sends the Damerons a letter promising that Shara will be remembered.

title: Finn is born
summary: The boy the First Order will seize as a toddler, number FN-2187 and train as a stormtrooper, is born. Years later Poe Dameron will give him the name Finn.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Spice Runners kill the Trune family
summary: Fleeing Republic patrols, a Spice Runners of Kijimi crew led by the Klatooinian Vigilch holes up on a Yungbrii farm and uses its family as shields. The shootout kills Sela Trune's family, and she later hunts the gang as a Republic security officer.

title: Imperial holdouts start stealing children
note: Finn's abduction is dated from his age (taken at three, 23 in 34 ABY). The First Order was formally organized only in 21 ABY, so these raids are credited to its emerging Imperial core.
summary: The Imperial forces that will become the First Order begin kidnapping children to raise as soldiers. Three-year-old Finn is taken in 14 ABY; in 15 ABY they seize two-year-old Kadara, Lando Calrissian's daughter, among other rebel leaders' children.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

title: Din Djarin smashes Barro's Imperial remnant
note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
summary: Now hunting Imperial warlords under Republic contract, Din and Grogu hit Commander Barro's base on icy Phostera and wreck his AT-AT column. Barro dies fleeing, a costly win: the Republic wanted him alive to expose his fellow warlords.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

title: Din unmasks and captures Janu Coin
note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
summary: Colonel Ward sends Din to recover Jabba's son Rotta, a gladiator on the moon Shakari, for the Hutt Twins. Din discovers that Janu, the moon's crime boss, is the Imperial warlord Coin, captures him, and hides Rotta instead of delivering him.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

title: The Hutt Twins fall on Nal Hutta
note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
summary: The bounty hunter Embo abducts Din for the vengeful Hutt Twins. Grogu and a crew of Anzellan droidsmiths free him; Din storms the Twins' palace, the Twins die, Republic fighters level it, and Rotta chooses to side with the New Republic.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

title: Luke Skywalker restores the Jedi Order
note: Dated 19 years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary; Luke was already building his temple and training Grogu by 9 ABY.
summary: From his temple on Ossus, Luke formally revives the Jedi Order and gathers a new class of students. Among them is his nephew Ben Solo, sent by Leia and Han to learn to master his formidable strength in the Force.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Rey is born on Hyperkarn
summary: Rey is born on Hyperkarn to Miramir and Dathan, a powerless clone grown from Emperor Palpatine's genetic template. Her parents live in hiding from the Sith cult that made him.

title: Ben Solo's rivalry with Voe flares
summary: At Luke's academy on Ossus, the gifted Ben Solo spars with fellow student Voe, who resents how easily the Force comes to him. Friction among Luke's apprentices foreshadows the night the academy falls.

title: Poe Dameron joins the Spice Runners
summary: Restless teenager Poe Dameron flies a stranded Spice Runners of Kijimi crew off Yavin 4 and signs on as their pilot, falling for Zorii Bliss, daughter of the gang's ruthless leader Zeva.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Luke and Ben meet the Knights of Ren
note: Skywalker: A Family at War places it in the year Ben turned fourteen.
summary: Luke, his apprentice Ben Solo and explorer Lor San Tekka search an old Jedi outpost on Elphrona for relics and run into the Knights of Ren, while Snoke, already whispering in Ben's mind, deepens the boy's doubts about his uncle and the Jedi.

title: Poe defies Zeva Bliss at the Kijimi summit
summary: Zeva Bliss lures underworld rivals to Kijimi to massacre them. Poe refuses to spring her trap, helps the guests escape, and survives a fight with Zeva only because Zorii stops her; he then quits the gang and heads home.
conflict: Poe Dameron: Free Fall, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to 18-19 ABY, has Poe quit the Spice Runners after this summit; The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary dates his departure to eleven years before the Starkiller Incident, i.e. 23 ABY.

title: Rey is left on Jakku; her parents die
summary: To hide their daughter from Palpatine's cult, Dathan and Miramir leave the young Rey on Jakku in the care of the scrap dealer Unkar Plutt. The Sith assassin Ochi of Bestoon catches them soon after and kills them.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Luke and Lando chase Ochi to Pasaana
summary: Sensing a tremor in the Force and chasing leads toward the Sith world Exegol, Luke and Lando Calrissian track Ochi to Pasaana but never catch him; the assassin dies stranded there. Lando stays behind among the desert's Aki-Aki.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: The First Order takes shape in secret
note: Star Wars: Timelines dates its formation to 21 ABY; it went public with the Centrist secession of 29 ABY.
summary: Far beyond Republic space, the scattered Imperial remnant regroups as the First Order, led early on by Rae Sloane and Brendol Hux, and quietly builds a new navy and army. The mysterious Snoke will rise to rule it as Supreme Leader.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: First Order secretly bankrolls its rearmament
summary: For seven years the First Order funnels money through Rinnrivin Di's smuggling and gambling cartel to arm the Amaxine warriors and build its navy. Leia exposes the scheme in 28 ABY and wrecks the Amaxine base on Sibensko, where Di dies.

title: Brendol Hux recruits Phasma on Parnassos
summary: Crash-landed on the harsh world Parnassos in the late Emperor's yacht, Brendol Hux is guided to safety by the Scyre fighter Phasma, who sells out her own clan to win a post with the First Order. She soon helps train its stormtroopers.

title: Amaxine terror strikes the Senate
summary: Secretly serving the First Order, Senator Carise Sindian has Amaxine militants bomb a Senate building on Hosnian Prime as a diversion. Soon after, Amaxine leader Arliz Hadrassian shoots Populist champion Tai-Lin Garr, then herself.

title: Vader revealed as Leia's father
summary: Manipulated by Carise Sindian, Centrist senator Ransolm Casterfo tells the Senate that Leia Organa is Darth Vader's daughter. The scandal wrecks her bid to become First Senator, and she leaves the Senate soon after.

title: Leia Organa founds the Resistance
summary: Out of the Senate and sure the First Order is real, Leia begins gathering trusted pilots and old rebel allies into a private force to watch it. The Resistance works outside the Republic's reluctant military.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
conflict: Bloodline (28 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) ends with Leia starting to build the Resistance, while The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary dates its formation to five years before the Starkiller Incident (29 ABY); Wookieepedia reads 29 ABY as the year it became operational.

title: Ben Solo destroys Luke's Jedi academy
note: Dated six years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
summary: Sensing Snoke's hold on Ben, Luke ignites his lightsaber over his sleeping nephew for one fatal instant. Ben wakes, the academy burns, and most students die. As Kylo Ren he seizes leadership of Ren's knights and hunts down those who pursue him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
conflict: The Last Jedi gives rival accounts of that night: Luke first says Ben simply turned on him, then admits he briefly ignited his lightsaber over his sleeping nephew, while Ben tells it as an attempt on his life.

title: Luke vanishes into exile on Ahch-To
note: Follows the academy's destruction, dated 28 ABY.
summary: Blaming himself for Ben's fall, Luke disappears. He retreats to Ahch-To, where the first Jedi temple stands, shuts out the Force, and leaves behind only a star map fragment pointing the way.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: First Order secession opens the Cold War
note: Dated five years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary; the Cold War lasts until the Hosnian Cataclysm.
summary: Centrist worlds such as Arkanis and Kuat quit the New Republic and openly side with the First Order. A tense standoff follows: the Order probes Republic borders and flouts the Concordance while a complacent Senate refuses to answer with force.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

title: Leia begins searching for Luke
note: Dated five years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
summary: As the First Order grows bolder, Leia starts hunting for her missing brother, hoping a returned Jedi can turn the tide. R2-D2, idle since his master left, powers down into low-power mode.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Phasma poisons Brendol Hux
summary: In league with his son Armitage, Captain Phasma kills Brendol Hux with the venom of a Parnassos beetle and hides the cause of his death. Armitage inherits his father's standing in the First Order.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Poe Dameron defects to the Resistance
note: Dated three years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
summary: After his Rapier Squadron clashes with First Order TIEs hijacking a freighter at Suraz 4, Republic commander Poe Dameron defies orders to chase the stolen ship. Leia takes notice, and Poe, his wingmates and BB-8 join the Resistance.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Pirates find clone trooper Kix frozen alive
summary: Rival pirate captains Sidon Ithano and Scorza race for 'Count Dooku's treasure' in a wrecked Separatist warship on Ponemah Terminal. The prize is Kix, a clone medic kept in stasis since he uncovered Order 66; he joins Ithano's crew.
sources: The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku

title: Gannis Ducain steals the Millennium Falcon
note: Placed after the Kix story and before Life Day 1, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to c. 31 ABY.
summary: Han Solo loses his Millennium Falcon to a thief, Gannis Ducain. Passed from thief to thief, the freighter ends up in junk boss Unkar Plutt's hands on Jakku, where it sits unused for years.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Flight of the Falcon, Part 5: Grand Theft Falcon

title: Black Squadron hunts for Lor San Tekka
note: Poe began leading Black Squadron two years before the Starkiller Incident; the hunt ends at Tuanul.
summary: Leia sends Poe Dameron's new Black Squadron after Lor San Tekka, an aging explorer who might know where Luke is. First Order agent Terex dogs them from world to world until the trail ends at Tuanul on Jakku.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Lanever Villecham becomes Chancellor
summary: The Senate elects Tarsunt's Lanever Villecham as Chancellor. A firm believer in the peace that followed the Concordance, he leads a Republic unwilling to treat the First Order as a real threat.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Poe recruits Kazuda Xiono as a spy
summary: Republic pilot Kazuda Xiono survives a First Order ambush alongside Poe Dameron and is recruited on the spot. Poe plants him as a mechanic on the Colossus, an ocean refueling platform on Castilon, to watch for First Order activity.
wp: Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance

title: The First Order occupies the Colossus
summary: After pirates kidnap his daughter Torra, Captain Imanuel Doza lets the First Order garrison the Colossus. Kaz and his friends go underground and rally the platform's people into their own resistance cell.

title: First Order massacres Tuanul
summary: Hunting the map to Luke, Kylo Ren's troops raze Tuanul, a village on Jakku. Kylo kills Lor San Tekka and seizes Poe Dameron, but BB-8 rolls off into the desert with the map hidden inside.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: FN-2187 defects and frees Poe
summary: Sickened by the Tuanul massacre, stormtrooper FN-2187 breaks Poe Dameron out of the Star Destroyer Finalizer, and the two escape in a hijacked TIE fighter. Poe names him Finn; they crash on Jakku and lose each other in the wreck.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: Rey and Finn flee Jakku in the Falcon
summary: Scavenger Rey flees a First Order strike on Niima Outpost with Finn and BB-8 aboard the junked Millennium Falcon. Han Solo and Chewbacca reclaim their old ship in space and agree to help carry the map.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: Starkiller Base destroys the Hosnian system
summary: Fired from the converted planet Ilum, Starkiller Base's beam crosses the galaxy and annihilates the Hosnian system, killing the Senate at the capital, Hosnian Prime, and much of the Republic fleet. The Cold War becomes open war.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: The Colossus breaks free into hyperspace
summary: As the Hosnian system burns, Kaz, Captain Doza and Jarek Yeager drive the First Order off the Colossus and fire up its long-dead engines, taking the whole platform into hyperspace. Kaz's friend Tam Ryvora stays behind and joins the Order.

title: First Order levels Maz Kanata's castle
summary: Tipped off that BB-8 is on Takodana, the First Order razes Maz Kanata's castle. Rey, who has just found Luke's old lightsaber there, is captured by Kylo Ren before Resistance X-wings drive the attackers off.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: Resistance destroys Starkiller Base
summary: The Resistance strikes Starkiller Base before it can fire on D'Qar, and Poe's X-wings blow it apart. Inside, Kylo Ren kills his father Han Solo; Rey, her Force strength awakened, defeats Kylo in the snow.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

title: Iden Versio dies avenging Del Meeko
summary: Former Imperial commando Iden Versio, her daughter Zay and Shriv Suurgav board the Star Destroyer Retribution to punish Gideon Hask for executing Del Meeko. Iden and Hask both die, but the team escapes with First Order intelligence.

title: Rey finds Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To
summary: With R2-D2's data completing the map, Rey and Chewbacca fly to Ahch-To and offer Luke his old lightsaber. Luke, shut off from the Force, refuses to return but grudgingly gives Rey three lessons before she leaves to reach Kylo Ren.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: Resistance flees D'Qar at heavy cost
summary: As the First Order fleet arrives over D'Qar, Poe Dameron's defiant attack opens a path for Resistance bombers, and Paige Tico drops the payload that destroys the dreadnought Fulminatrix. Every bomber is lost, and Leia demotes Poe.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: First Order ambushes the fleeing Resistance
summary: Using new hyperspace tracking, the First Order catches the Resistance fleet. A strike on the Raddus kills Admiral Ackbar and most of the command staff; Leia survives the vacuum through the Force, and Vice Admiral Holdo assumes command.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: Finn and Rose seek a codebreaker
summary: Hoping to disable the tracker, Finn and Rose Tico fly to Canto Bight, a gambling resort on Cantonica, free a herd of fathiers, and hire the slicer DJ, who later sells them out to the First Order.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: Kylo Ren kills Supreme Leader Snoke
summary: Brought before Snoke aboard the Supremacy, Rey watches Kylo Ren cut his master in half. Together they kill the Praetorian Guards, but Rey refuses to rule beside him, and Kylo names himself Supreme Leader.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: Holdo rams the Supremacy at lightspeed
summary: To shield the escaping transports, Vice Admiral Holdo turns the Raddus and jumps to lightspeed straight through the Supremacy, splitting Snoke's flagship and crippling much of the fleet around it.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: Luke's last stand at Crait
summary: The First Order besieges the surviving Resistance fighters in an old rebel base on Crait. Luke, projecting his image from distant Ahch-To, faces Kylo Ren, buying time for them to flee on the Falcon, then passes peacefully into the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

title: The Resistance rebuilds after Crait
summary: From a cave base on Ryloth, the survivors rally old rebels such as Norra Wexley and Wedge Antilles, free Ransolm Casterfo on Corellia, and gather ships. A First Order raid forces them to abandon Ryloth and scatter to new hideouts.

title: Kylo Ren retraces Darth Vader's past
note: Set after The Last Jedi and before the Battle of Batuu, both dated 34 ABY by Star Wars: Timelines.
summary: Now Supreme Leader, Kylo Ren chases his grandfather's history from Vader's fortress on Mustafar to Tatooine and Naboo. On Naboo he secretly stokes the rebellion his troops then fight; when Vader's former aide Vaneé exposes this, he withdraws and has the rebels wiped out.

title: Hux annihilates Tah'Nuhna
summary: As punishment for supplying the Resistance, General Hux's forces aboard the Finalizer lay waste to Tah'Nuhna, with TIE bombers flattening its capital and seat of government.

title: The Colossus destroys the Thunderer
summary: Horrified when the First Order bombs Aeos Prime for sheltering the Colossus, Tam Ryvora defects. Kaz's team knocks out the Star Destroyer Thunderer's shields, Jade and Ace Squadrons destroy it with Commander Pyre aboard, and Kylo Ren executes Agent Tierny.

title: Resistance and First Order clash on Batuu
note: Four to six months after the Hosnian Cataclysm.
summary: Some months after Hosnian Prime's destruction, Vi Moradi and the ex-trooper Archex found a Resistance cell at Black Spire Outpost. Then the Order's 709th Legion seizes the town, and the Finalizer is crippled overhead, sending Kylo Ren to the Steadfast.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: First Order fails to take Coruscant
note: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire places it during the First Order-Resistance War (34-35 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines); the exact date is unknown.
summary: The First Order sends at least two large task forces to seize Coruscant, the old Imperial capital, and is beaten back. The failed push stays murky; historian Beaumont Kin later cites a First Order file about it.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

title: Palpatine's voice promises revenge
summary: A transmission in the voice of the long-dead Emperor Palpatine spreads across the galaxy, vowing revenge. Its source is Exegol, the Sith Eternal's secret world, and it sends both Kylo Ren and the Resistance hunting for the truth.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Kylo Ren finds Sidious alive on Exegol
summary: Following a Sith wayfinder from Vader's castle on Mustafar, Kylo Ren reaches Exegol and finds a revived Darth Sidious. The Emperor claims he made Snoke and offers Kylo the Final Order, a fleet of planet-killing Star Destroyers, if he kills Rey.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Rey's team follows Ochi's trail to Pasaana
summary: Following Luke's notes, Rey, Poe and Finn reach Pasaana, with Chewbacca and two droids, during its Festival of the Ancestors. With Lando's help they find Ochi's ship and dagger, but the First Order seizes Chewbacca, whom they believe killed.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Hux is exposed as the Resistance spy
summary: On Kijimi the team pulls a Sith translation from C-3PO's memory, then raids the Steadfast to rescue Chewbacca, where Kylo tells Rey she is Palpatine's granddaughter. General Hux reveals he is their spy; Allegiant General Pryde shoots him and takes command.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Leia dies and Ben Solo returns
summary: Rey recovers the Emperor's wayfinder from the Death Star wreck on Kef Bir, but Kylo crushes it and they duel on the ruins. Leia spends her last strength reaching her son and dies; Rey heals Kylo, and Ben Solo turns back to the light.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: The Final Order destroys Kijimi
summary: To prove the First Order's loyalty to Sidious, Allegiant General Pryde has the Final Order destroyer Derriphan turn its planet-cracking cannon on Kijimi, wiping out the world.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: Battle of Exegol ends the Sith
summary: Lando and Chewbacca lead a citizens' fleet to Exegol and break the Final Order. Below, Rey and Ben Solo face Sidious; Rey turns his lightning back and destroys him, dies, and is revived by Ben, who then fades into the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

title: The galaxy rises against the First Order
summary: News from Exegol sparks revolts on Endor, Bespin, Naboo, Jakku, Lothal and other occupied worlds, toppling First Order control, while the Resistance celebrates and mourns at its base on Ajan Kloss.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel

title: Rey takes the Skywalker name
summary: Rey travels to Tatooine and the deserted Lars homestead, buries Luke's and Leia's lightsabers, and ignites her own new yellow blade. When a passerby asks her name, she answers 'Rey Skywalker' as the twins' spirits look on.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

title: Beaumont Kin excavates the Sith Citadel
summary: Months after the battle, Resistance historian Beaumont Kin leads a dig through Exegol's Sith Citadel. Scrolls and relics found there expose Palpatine's Sith lineage, including his master Darth Plagueis, and feed Kin's history of the Empire.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

title: Rey Skywalker rebuilds the Jedi Order
note: From an announced, unreleased film; Kathleen Kennedy (Star Wars Celebration 2023) set it about fifteen years after The Rise of Skywalker.
summary: Some fifteen years after Exegol, Jedi Master Rey Skywalker sets about building a new Jedi Order, the story of a film Lucasfilm has announced but not yet released.

title: A Whill begins writing Episode IV
yText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)
note: Undated ('a long time after the Battle of Yavin'); placed just after the last dated entry (c. 50 ABY) only so it sorts at the end of the timeline.
summary: Long after these events, one of the Whills is asked to set the galaxy's history down in the Whills' journal for readers far away. The Whill starts with 'Episode IV', while a fussier colleague writes about a Wookiee family's Life Day.

title: The Graf Archive publishes the Galactic Atlas
yText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)
note: Undated ('a long time after the Battle of Yavin'); placed just after the last dated entry (c. 50 ABY) only so it sorts at the end of the timeline.
summary: Maps drawn by the artist Gammit Chond from stories of the galaxy sit forgotten in the Graf Archive's Shadow Stacks until a trainee archivist unearths them. The archive publishes them as the Galactic Atlas, later expanded with newfound notes.
sources: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition
